introduction.value:

method.value: One commenter connected Claude to Gmail plus PocketSmith, which pulled bank and loan transaction data through Australia’s Open Banking system, then fed that into a Home Assistant financial dashboard updated daily with weekly budget and cashflow forecasts. Claude classified transactions, flagged new bill changes, reconciled real-estate agent statements against bank records, and drafted the follow-up email when it found a discrepancy.

outcome.value: They said it caught an agent overcharge and saved about $1,000, then helped answer the agent’s explanations. The thread frames this as useful, but also as a personal setup built around the commenter’s own tools and risk tolerance.

notes.value: The key catch is access: this depended on Gmail plus a PocketSmith connector for real-time financial data, and the commenter explicitly decided the benefits outweighed the privacy risks.

source_text.body:
Query bank statements and reconcile property records with Claude
Commenters gave Claude email access to find receipts and ask about statements and portfolios, and one has it reconcile real-estate agent statements to bank records.
·
Oct 31, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
One commenter connected Claude to Gmail plus PocketSmith, which pulled bank and loan transaction data through Australia’s Open Banking system, then fed that into a Home Assistant financial dashboard updated daily with weekly budget and cashflow forecasts. Claude classified transactions, flagged new bill changes, reconciled real-estate agent statements against bank records, and drafted the follow-up email when it found a discrepancy.
How it went
They said it caught an agent overcharge and saved about $1,000, then helped answer the agent’s explanations. The thread frames this as useful, but also as a personal setup built around the commenter’s own tools and risk tolerance.
Worth knowing
The key catch is access: this depended on Gmail plus a PocketSmith connector for real-time financial data, and the commenter explicitly decided the benefits outweighed the privacy risks.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Search my email for receipts and statements from [vendor, agent or account name] covering [time period], and match each payment or deposit against the transactions in the bank statement I'm uploading. Produce a reconciliation table showing matched items, unmatched items on either side, and amount differences. Finish with a short list of discrepancies I should follow up on, and don't send or change anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/claude/comments/1xkmzet/has_anyone_used_claude_to_build_an_allinone
